GTU- Graduate School , Directorate of Student Affairs and International Relations Office do not assume any responsibility for late/non-arrival of documents or postal delay. The documents which are not received on time will not be processed.
According to the Directive s for International Graduate Students of GTU, the Institute will inquire the acceptability of the diploma by Turkish Council of Higher Education (YÖK). T he application form will be processed in the semester that follows the approval of YÖK. Therefore, you are recommended to apply as early as possible for the semester you plan to start.
Before filling in this application form, you are recommended to contact the head of or your possible academic advisor in the program for which you intend to apply in order to find out program-related requirements such as GRE, TOEFL scores .
For more information about the degree programs offered by GTU, please visit https://abl.gtu.edu.tr/ects/?dil=en
Please remember to submit the official or certified copies ( of all the documents required as per GTU’s Directive s for International Graduate Students together with this application form.
Documents that must be provided with the application form:
 Notarized or Official Translator-Approved Bachelor's and Master's Transcript
 Notarized or Official Translator-Approved Bachelor's and Master's Diploma
 Passport
 CV (Curriculum Vitae)
 Reference Letter
 ALES (Academic Personnel and Graduate Education Entrance Exam given in Türkiye) o r Equivalent (GRE ,GMAT ) Certificate *
 English Language Certificate (YDS-Foreign Language Proficiency Exam given in Türkiye) or equivalent ( TOEFL iBT ) *
* Applicants that do not have ALES and YDS certificates are given conditional acceptance and can start their education.
